## Top-Rated 24/7 Emergency Plumbers in Raleigh

## Immediate Steps to Take Right Now

- Shut off the water: Locate your main water shutoff valve (usually in the basement, crawl space, near the water heater, or out by the street/water meter) and turn it completely off.
- Turn off electricity: If water is near electrical panels, outlets, or appliances, turn off the electricity to those areas at the breaker box.
- Drain the lines: Open your lowest-elevation faucets to drain remaining water out of the plumbing system.

Are you seeing water actively pooling or leaking into ceilings, or do you need help finding your main water shutoff valve right now?
